description: This is an abstract Java class defining a base monitoring service with methods for initialization, running checks, and managing health checkers and targets within the Thingsboard monitoring system.

classes.name: BaseMonitoringService
classes.description: An abstract class providing core monitoring functionalities, including initialization, health check execution, and device management within the Thingsboard monitoring framework.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes health checkers for configured targets and their associated URLs if domain IP checking is enabled.

methods.name: runChecks
methods.description: Executes the monitoring checks, including login, WebSocket subscriptions, health checks, and optional EDQS validation, with error handling and reporting.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs health checks on a given health checker and updates associated URLs if domain IPs are checked.

methods.name: checkEdqs
methods.description: Queries entity data to verify the presence and correctness of device information, throwing exceptions if inconsistencies are found.

methods.name: getAssociatedUrls
methods.description: Resolves a base URL to its associated IP addresses and constructs URLs for each IP.

methods.name: getTestTelemetryKeys
methods.description: Returns telemetry keys used for testing, including calculated fields if enabled.

methods.name: stopHealthChecker
methods.description: Stops a health checker and removes its device from the active list.

methods.name: createHealthChecker
methods.description: Abstract method to create a health checker instance for a given configuration and target.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Abstract method to create a target instance from a base URL.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Abstract method to return the name of the monitoring service.
